result:
PLAT-101 is live: the billing component now shows a "Manage billing" link to https://homelab.local/billing/portal. PR #1 on `mono` is merged, CI and CD both passed, and I've run `st done`.

- **Shared config:** I added `billingPortalUrl` to `SHARED_CONFIG` in `libs/shared-contracts/index.js`. I kept `billingUrl` as it was.
- **Billing app:** `apps/sub-route-billing/src/main.js` reads the address from `SHARED_CONFIG.billingPortalUrl`, so nothing is hardcoded there. A local build passed the contract check, and the compiled bundle contains the link.

**Assumptions:**
- I treated `libs/shared-contracts` as the "shared configuration", since it already holds the other environment URLs.
- The link opens in the same tab and has simple green styling, because the ticket doesn't specify either.

Nothing surprised me or slowed me down. `libs/shared-contracts` is inlined into the billing bundle at build time, and `Jenkinsfile.cd` only picks up changes under `apps/`. Because I also changed billing's `main.js`, billing deployed. A change to the config alone would not have deployed anything.
